editorial: Forget every heist trope you know and prepare for a familial meltdown at 100 miles per hour. You get a volatile mix of high-stakes larceny and deeply dysfunctional DNA that transforms a standard robbery into a psychological battleground. Thomas Vincent nails the tension, ensuring the friction between the long-lost siblings feels more dangerous than the Louvre's security system. If you crave a thriller where the emotional stakes are as high as the monetary ones, this is your next obsession.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of high-concept heists and complex family dynamics.
